subject: Banking
title: Chatbots and Virtual Assistants
description: Learn Chatbots and Virtual Assistants in one minute.

hook.text: Bank of America's virtual assistant Erica has handled over 1.5 billion customer interactions since 2018.

buildup.text: Banking chatbots handle balance inquiries, payment scheduling, spending insights, and dispute filing.

discovery.text: Large language models now let chatbots understand complex requests.

twist.text: Air Canada's chatbot gave a customer incorrect refund information.

climax.text: AI assistants reduce costs but create liability. When the bot makes a mistake, the bank still owns the consequences.

punchline.text: 1.5 billion interactions, zero breaks. But one wrong promise creates liability.

quiz.question: What legal issue arose from Air Canada's chatbot?
options: The airline was held legally responsible for incorrect information the chatbot provided
